SELECT

FROM bidding_management WHERE project_status = 1 AND bid_deadline > SYSDATE ORDER BY bid_deadline ASC

SELECT
FROM bidding_management WHERE project_status IN (1, 2) AND bid_deadline < SYSDATE ORDER BY bid_deadline DESC

SELECT
FROM bidding_management WHERE budget_amount >= #{minBudgetAmount} ORDER BY budget_amount DESC

SELECT
FROM bidding_management WHERE project_status = 1 AND bid_deadline BETWEEN SYSDATE AND SYSDATE + 3 ORDER BY bid_deadline ASC

FROM bidding_management WHERE manager_id = #{managerId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(winning_amount), 0) FROM bidding_management WHERE project_status = 4
